objectives.text: Add Spring Boot Actuator and read the aggregate status from /actuator/health, then enable component visibility with management.endpoint.health.show-components (component and detail visibility default to never; expose them only to trusted callers) and read the database health contributor's status
Expose only the endpoints you need over HTTP and explain why other Actuator endpoints stay unexposed by default
Explain how liveness and readiness health groups are used by a platform that restarts or routes traffic to the service

minutes.basis: intake planning model under the new-course budget rule (authoring/docs/tools/validators.md, Reading time): no artifact.html exists yet, so modeledP50 is the intake target for a core page (9 minutes) and modeledWorstPath adds 2.5 minutes for the worst required route (two wrong graded attempts and wrong-first explores per interactive unit; course-1 measured worst-path gaps were 2.41-2.65 minutes above P50). budget = aboutLabel = ceil(max(modeledP50, modeledWorstPath)) = 12. The integration-and-observability module PR replaces modeledP50 with the frozen estimator P50 (authoring/tools/timing/estimate_reading.py, sha256 0deca96bf5e367aeae51a82abdbd4b6ce0d0289ecc9868c9eff3701016edf96f) on the authored bytes, re-models the worst path, and keeps budget at least ceil(max(P50, worst path)) and at most 15; T14 then checks the day totals. See authoring/evidence/spring-boot/intake.md, section Minute budgets.
